This encoding models the Treasure prose. She is a TANK: most of the kit is defensive/utility and inert in the v1 DPS sim (no incoming damage, no HP pool, no taunt/Attract primitive). MODELED (L1,L4,L5,L6,L7): (S1/L1) fullBurstEnter -> self -> defPct 25.92 for 10s — FAITHFUL but INERT in v1 (self DEF does not feed own damage; defPct is the Endurance-cube channel, parsed-but-inert). (S2/L4) hitCount:70 -> self -> maxAmmoPct 56.7, maxStacks 10, 10s — 'Strawberry Candy: Max Ammunition Capacity ▲56.7% x10 stacks, 10s'; the Treasure threshold is 70 NA (base was 100). LIVE: a larger magazine means fewer reloads -> more firing uptime -> a real (small) DPS gain. (S2/L5) hitCount:700 -> all allies -> instantReload fraction 0.8662 + pierceDamagePct 30 for 10s — 'when the skill user reaches max stacks of Strawberry Candy ... Reload 86.62% of the magazine; Pierce Damage ▲30% for 10s'. The engine has NO buff-stack-threshold / on-stack-removal trigger, so 'reaches max stacks (10) then removed' is approximated as the cumulative 700th NA (= 10 x 70-NA procs = one full Strawberry Candy cycle), repeating — the same hitCount 'max stacks' approximation as ade-agent-bunny (⚑1). pierceDamagePct feeds Damage Up ONLY for pierce-tagged attackers (sim.ts pierceTagged); diesel and a generic comp have no pierce, so that half is inert unless a pierce ally is present — the DPS-relevant half is the instantReload (no event; refills 86.62% of each ally's magazine). (burst/L6) burstCast -> enemy -> flatDamage 299.66 — '5 enemies with the highest final ATK, 299.66% of final ATK as damage'; the v1 boss is a single partless target so '5 enemies' collapses to the one boss (standard multi-target-burst convention). Burst CAST lands BEFORE the Full Burst window, so it never takes the +50% FB major (verified fact). (burst/L7) burstCast -> self -> targetMaxHpPct 100.05 for 10s — 'Max HP ▲100.05% without restoring HP for 10s'; FAITHFUL but INERT (diesel has no atkOfMaxHpPct feed, so self Max HP moves no damage; targetMaxHpPct -> maxHpFlat self-grant in sim.ts). UNMODELED (verbatim, L2/L3/L8 — all inert for DPS, no engine primitive): S1 'when attacked in Attract status -> Recovers 12.96% final Max HP' (no incoming-damage event in v1; boss deals no damage) and 'after landing 150 normal attacks in Attract status -> Stack count of buffs ▲1' (gated on an unmodeled self-Attract status; effect 'Stack count of buffs ▲1' is ambiguous); burst 'Attract: Taunt all enemies for 10s' (no taunt/Attract primitive; tanking is out of domain for a DPS sim). FLAGS (UNMEASURED): (⚑1) L5 trigger fidelity — 'reaches 10 simultaneous stacks then removed' is modeled as the cumulative 700th-NA cycle; with a 10s stack duration, whether 10 stacks actually accumulate within the window rests on MG cadence (rate_of_fire ramps 60 -> 4200 in the datamine). If stacks lapse before maxing, the real effect fires LESS often than hitCount:700 (over-credit risk); if MG sustains ~70 NA/<=10s it matches. recipe = a Diesel:Treasure focus video reading rounds/min + whether Strawberry Candy visibly reaches 10 stacks. (⚑2) MG cadence tuple (rate_of_fire 60->4200 / reloadFrames 151) is the unverified datamine driving the L4 stack accrual rate + the L5 700-NA timing; recipe = read rounds/min + reload gap from footage. SAME-MODEL RESIDUALS: L1/L7 are inert-by-design (tank stats), pinned inert in the unit spec; L5 pierceDamagePct is inert without a pierce ally (documented, not fudged).

skill2: Strawberry Candy stack-REFRESH semantics are assumed standard (a new stack refreshes the older stacks' 10s timers, so sustained MG fire holds 10 stacks) — adopted from the S6 blind override (kimi S7 judge verdict).
